17/S0.subgoal: Explain what IMU sensors are and how their gyroscope, accelerometer, and magnetometer readings are used in tracking.

17/S1.subgoal: Describe how calibration maps cheap sensor readings to ideal values by estimating a mathematical relationship from paired samples using least-squares regression.

17/S2.subgoal: Explain how registration sets the initial orientation and integration updates the current orientation by summing calibrated angular velocity samples over time.

17/S3.subgoal: Describe how drift correction uses multiple sensors and a gain parameter to combine orientations and reduce estimation error.

17/S4.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next part on sensing technologies.
